implementation.name: JT1942
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the HDL lives in the jotego/jtcores monorepo at cores/1942/, 10 source files. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id, license_id and implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. License: https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GPLv3 text, and the per-file grant in https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/cores/1942/hdl/jt1942_colmix.v reads "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-3.0-or-later. Machine mapping: 10 MRA files in jotego/jtbin's mra/ directory name <rbf>jt1942</rbf>; 3 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 7 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 3 distinct machine_id rows. hdl_language_id: 10 of 10 HDL files are verilog (10 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: jotego's README claims faithfulness in prose but states no timing-fidelity level this build could check against data/lookup/accuracy_level.json.
